Bexar Appraisal District · Data exports (on request)

Bexar Property Data Profile

About this page

Everything Bexar Appraisal District gives us as bulk files, from three exports: the PACS Appraisal Export (18 files, two snapshots: the March 28 first-notice preliminary roll and the October 15 export as of supplement 298), the Agent Export (21 CSV files, October 26) and the Property Summary file (March 28 and October 13). For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness, value distributions and 100 sample rows.

Team review: mark each column Need, Maybe or Drop and leave notes in the column table. A decision or note on a column applies to the same raw file in every download that has it. Everyone with access sees changes live.

Sources: help.bcad.org/hc/en-us/articles/55264219130899-What-is-a-Public-Information-Act-Request (checked 2026-11-27) · our copies in Google Drive · Bexar › Public Information. Pick a file below, or search for a table or column at the top.

Notes and decisions load when this page is opened on claude.ai.
